execute: Separate credential origin, acquisition prerequisites, recognition, enabled grant, issuance, audience/scope acceptance and final action. Record issuer, tenant, actor, purpose, lifetime, session and deployment where known. Link the exact product through references or digests; do not expose raw secrets in guidance. Compare the valid normal flow and failing stage. Credentials from unrelated legitimate enrollment cannot complete a chain with another origin. Decoded claims are unverified metadata. Several replays show only observed reuse, not infinite mintability, no expiry or persistence.
review: Support only the deepest connected capability observed. Recognition, bearer text, decoded admin claims or intermediate session IDs are insufficient for final impact. A valid consumer rejection refutes that branch without erasing issuance. Missing grant, key, binding or result remains a gap. Stop at the necessary blocker; reopen for changed dependency, consumer policy, lifetime, revocation or acceptance path.
